title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f68v2 four centres versus eight flanks as a season and month role contrast
summary: The admitted f68v2 diagram has four repeated centre-plus-two-flank units, and an independently readable Laon calendar assigns twelve months to four season figures in the same three-part layout. Test only whether the Voynich centre positions and flank positions carry a stable role distinction under the fixed manuscript order. A season/month interpretation remains conditional on demonstrating the owner relation in the Voynich drawing; the Laon layout alone cannot translate an inscription. Existing f68 terminal-y and astronomical-dictionary nonconfirmations are retained.

design.mechanism: external source licenses a positional season/month role hypothesis for a diagram with twelve explicitly positioned inscriptions
design.unit: all twelve f68v2 inscriptions, preassigned as four centre and eight flank slots before reading strings
design.contrast: the four centre slots versus the eight flank slots, with cyclic phase and direction treated as explicit alternatives
design.prediction: a whole-inscription interpretation that assigns seasonal role to centres and month role to flanks must cover all twelve slots and remain coherent under each actual alternate reading; if the graphic order or owner assignment is uncertain, stop before lexical scoring
design.scope: admitted f68v2 source and existing source-family report; exploratory capacity screen before any fixed test
